mainEntity.name: What courses are offered at SmartEdge Academy in Bhiwandi?

acceptedAnswer.text: SmartEdge Academy offers 21+ industry-aligned courses across Software Engineering (Java, Python, MERN Stack, React, Cloud & DevOps, SQL), Data Careers (Data Science, Data Analyst, Power BI), and AI & Automation (ChatGPT for Professionals, Google Gemini, Antigravity AI, and n8n Workflow Automation).

mainEntity.name: Can non-IT graduates (BCom, BSc, BA, 12th Pass) join coding courses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely! All SmartEdge Academy programs start from ground zero fundamentals and guide students through hands-on project building. Graduates from BCom, MCom, Plain BSc, Arts, or Engineering can successfully transition into high-growth software and data roles.

mainEntity.name: What is the 100% Job Assistance policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: SmartEdge Academy provides 100% Job Assistance support services including ATS-compliant resume creation, live GitHub project portfolio showcases, simulated 1-on-1 mock interviews with senior engineers, and active corporate hiring referrals.

mainEntity.name: Where is SmartEdge Academy located in Bhiwandi?

acceptedAnswer.text: The campus is located at 1st Floor, Laxmi Ajit Complex, Mubeen Master Road, Near Shiv Mandir, Opp. Curewell Pharmacy, Gauripada, Samad Nagar, Bhiwandi, Maharashtra 421305. You can call or WhatsApp admissions at +91 98206 24436.

mainEntity.name: How can I book a Free Career Counselling session?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can book a free 1-on-1 career counselling session directly on our website at academy.smartedgegroup.in/career-counselling or by messaging our counsellors on WhatsApp at +91 98206 24436.
